trap.label: revisão unidade 9
trap.wrong: Do you know where is my seat? She is good in chess. The man who he called me is rude.
trap.right: Do you know where my seat is? She is good at chess. The man who called me is rude.
trap.why: Revisão da unidade 9: pergunta indireta com ordem afirmativa, preposição at e who sem pronome duplicado. O português permite a ordem direta e o pronome repetido.

mcq.q: Could you tell me where ___ now?

fix.wrong: Tell me what does it mean.
The tool that it helps is free.
fix.right: The tool that helps is free.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “Where is my seat?” (Do you know...)
rewrite.answer: Do you know where my seat is?

rewrite.prompt: Una com who: “I met a woman. She is bilingual.”
rewrite.answer: I met a woman who is bilingual.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com good at: “She plays chess well.”
rewrite.answer: She is good at playing chess.
